accuracyShadow.note: Same-side calibration, not a new multiclass predictor. Coverage is relative to locked 2% shift candidates, not all listed games. No betting recommendation; no automatic promotion.

sportShadow.note: Exploratory frozen forecasts; miss cohorts are associations, not causal diagnosis. Missing starters are not verified injuries. No player impact weights; no auto promotion.

coverageShadow.note: Independent fresh cohort. Fixed experimental thresholds. Missing lineup is unknown, not injury. Audit cohorts overlap and are not causal.

earlyShadow.note: Early research only. Lock T-85..T-65; 5-minute reserve is not a guaranteed publication SLA. Known deadline misses exclude fixtures never observed. No retrospective replacement or late lineup update.

collectionPipeline.note: 진짜 경기 전 시각·배당·선발 명단과 경기 종료 후 검증된 점수를 별개로 집계. 결과만 발견된 경기는 예측 학습에서 제외.
